The Kubernetes documentation doesn't provide details about NGINX-specific redirect annotations. However, based on the ticket description, the issue is clear: the ingress controller was upgraded over the weekend, and the custom redirects using regex capture groups that relied on old NGINX features stopped working. 

The ticket mentions that the redirects "use regex capture groups that the standard redirect annotations can't express." This indicates they were previously using a feature that is no longer supported in the new version (v1.12.1).
